PINGGU, China, Sept. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The 2026 World AgriFood Innovation Conference opened in Pinggu on Friday, with exhibitors from thirty countries showing seed, irrigation and food processing technologies.
The organisers said cooperation agreements worth several billion yuan were signed on the first day.
